test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

#: VTP:: KIE: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

Given:

#: VTP:: KIE: %

Analysis of Options:

Option 1) # = QNK, % = PUY

For # (QNK) to VTP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/725aac7cf6293034ad3e0c9cfe60bec92bd8fcecea990a3ef224337bd20bdcbe.png] 

For KIE to % (PUY)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0069d8c8b368c5d5cc117eee3a51c401d40f332c844c0154d9fae39d3b01d79.png] 

 

Option 2) # = RTK, % = PKJ

For # (RTK) to VTP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78b90eb9d51513d866e56467ca6023166db5e4f2a7477c2eb39f3c87cbcd4d06.png] 

 

For KIE to % (PKJ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dbdb97ff3dec741d56aef6a13b6cf33d4884ba506c3583b34f1d0f2d70e7014.png] 

 

**Option 3) # = QOK, % = PNJ**

**For # (QOK) to VTP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/681ae051aa34b4616e3e23f872967ebe4b01714cc5bdccee4d083bb382eb49fa.png] 

 

**For KIE to % (PNJ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dbdb97ff3dec741d56aef6a13b6cf33d4884ba506c3583b34f1d0f2d70e7014.png] 

 

**Since the patterns match, Option 3 is correct.**

Option 4) # = LOY, % = PKJ

For # (LOY) to VTP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e200bb5cee8562bae1010aa70b46f24f50dee15ed92d1ff4a61e3a48fd977155.png] 

 

For KIE to % (PKJ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/171e4f58bfb6454f7d21c88c08efe04baac2cc618fcf89d8fc5ea8b8bc25dd16.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
